2. Which sectors are leading?

Secondary: Materials (DOW ABOVE TREND: DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%)) and selective Consumer Discretionary strength (ROST ABOVE TREND: ROST (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +11.63%)); Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5, Tech-heavy).

3. Which sectors are lagging?

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but relatively strong vs peers: AVGO ABOVE TREND: AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%), SHOP ABOVE TREND: SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%), INTU ABOVE TREND: INTU (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +2.29%); several megacaps are RECOVERY (INTC RECOVERY: INTC (1W: +8.54% | 1M: -7.53%), NVDA RECOVERY: NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -0.35%), GOOGL RECOVERY: GOOGL (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -4.83%)). Sector breadth: Technology is the only sector positive; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials under pressure with broad weakness: JPM BELOW TREND: JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%), BLK BELOW TREND: BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%), V BELOW TREND: V (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -4.98%). Sector skew is negative and reinforces the RISK-OFF backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed and defensive names showing exhaustion: JNJ CORRECTION: JNJ (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +2.09%), UNH CORRECTION: UNH (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.85%), LLY BELOW TREND: LLY (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -5.21%), PFE RECOVERY: PFE (1W: +2.18% | 1M: -0.22%). Sector breadth negative and acting as a partial flight-to-safety that is not yet broad-based.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
In RISK-OFF, reduce exposure to cyclical beta and highly concentrated mega-cap longs; favor selective defensive and cash positioning. Style: Defensive / no clear growth leadership — monitor RECOVERY names (INTC, AMD, NVDA) for confirmation before increasing exposure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?

AAPL breach of recent 1M lows would reinforce downside (AAPL BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -6.13%)). JPM reclaiming a 1M resistance would be required to shift Financials out of BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

AVGO ABOVE TREND: AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%), DOW ABOVE TREND: DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%), SHOP ABOVE TREND: SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) showing relative strength.
